entries.en: Perhaps against your better judgment, you have elected to take on the Eorzean Nimble Warrior obstacle course, which has been revamped this year to be more challenging than ever. As per Beaudefoin's instructions, propel yourself up to the starting line by hopping on the nearby water spout, then carefully make your way across a series of precarious platforms to reach the midway point. When you arrive, be sure to report to the chaperone stationed there before proceeding on to the finish.
entries.fr:
Cette quête ne peut être commencée et effectuée que pendant la durée de l'événement saisonnier correspondant. Pour plus de détails, veuillez consulter The Lodestone.

La responsable des ins<->crip<->tions de l'attraction “Pas dans l'tas” s'est occupé d'enregistrer votre par<->ti<->ci<->pa<->tion et Beaudefoin vous a expliqué comment procéder: utiliser le petit geyser pour monter, atteindre la mi-parcours et s'adresser à la personne là-bas, puis se diriger vers l'arrivée où attend P'obyano. Commencez par aller parler au responsable de mi-parcours.

entries.en: Though there were times when you thought you might take an unfortunate tumble, you have impressively managed to reach the midway point of the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course. The chaperone in attendance offers you words of congratulations and caution before encouraging you to forge your way forward to the finish line, where her colleague P'obyano awaits.
entries.fr: Celui-ci vous a félicité<if(gnum4,e,)> et vous a encouragé<if(gnum4,e,)> à poursuivre vos efforts jusqu'à l'arrivée où vous attend P'obyano.
entries.ja: 最初の中継地点に到達して、魔城の中継担当に報告した。最後のエリアを渡り切り、コスタ・デル・ソルにいる「魔城の終着担当ペ・オビヤノ」に報告しよう。

entries.en: You have successfully navigated your way to the finish line of the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, doubtless to the joy of anyone who was fortunate enough to witness your remarkable run. You claim your hard-earned prize of four Faire vouchers, leaving open the option of returning to showcase your skills yet again while the festivities are still ongoing.
entries.fr: La Miqo'te du comité d'or<->ga<->ni<->sa<->tion des Feux de la Mort vous a congratulé<if(gnum4,e,)> pour votre performance et vous a invité<if(gnum4,e,)> à participer à nouveau à cette attraction.
entries.ja: ペ・オビヤノに報告し、常夏の魔城の攻略が完了した。冒険者ギルドの一員として紅蓮祭を盛り上げるために、また挑戦してみるのもよいだろう。

entries.en: Welcome, friend. I trust you're here to try your hand─or would that be your feet?─at the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, yes? Wonderful! My colleague here will get you signed up straightaway!
entries.fr: Bienvenue à “Pas dans l'tas”<nbsp>! L'attraction phare des Feux de la Mort<nbsp>! Vous voulez participer<nbsp>? Je m'en occupe<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
「常夏の魔城」へようこそ！
さっそく、参加受付しますね！

おーいえぇい！

entries.en: Very well, then! Without further ado, allow me to explain the rules of the challenge in full. Pay close attention, now─you never know what small morsel of knowledge may prove the difference between a glorious victory and a humiliating defeat!
entries.fr: Je vais d'abord t'expliquer les règles, alors ouvre grand tes oreilles<nbsp>! Pour commencer, tu dois monter sur le petit geyser un peu plus loin pour arriver tout en haut du parcours de “Pas dans l'tas”<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
最初にルールを説明しておくから、耳の穴かっぽじってよく聞けよ！
まずは、そこの地面にある噴流に乗って、
「常夏の魔城」の上まで大ジャンプしてくれ！

entries.en: First, just hop atop that jet of water and let it propel you with a splash to the start of the course! From there, you'll have to navigate a sequence of precarious platforms and narrow ledges to make your way to the central checkpoint. Two hints for you: move cautiously, and try not to look down!
entries.fr: Une fois là-haut, tu devras te diriger vers le responsable de mi-parcours<nbsp>! Mais fais bien attention à ne pas tomber en route<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
「常夏の魔城」の上に来たら、
まずは「魔城の中継担当」を目指して、
落ちないように足場を渡りやがれ！

entries.en: When you reach the checkpoint, the first thing you'll want to do is speak with the chaperone stationed there. It's her job to confirm that all competitors have completed the full course fair and square, you see. From there, it's a straight shot to the goal, where my colleague P'obyano awaits.
entries.fr: Une fois que tu auras passé cette étape, il ne te restera plus qu'à viser l'arrivée<nbsp>! Ma collègue P'obyano t'y accueillera<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
忘れずに「魔城の中継担当」と話したら、
あとはひたすらゴールを目指せ！
「魔城の終着担当ペ・オビヤノ」がゴールで待ってるぜー！

entries.en: The course may appear imposing, as well it should─Master Gegeruju's really pulled out all the stops this year. But fear not! You can take as much time as you'd like, and in the event that you should take an unfortunate and premature tumble, you can simply swim your way back to the starting point and try again!
entries.fr: Ne t'inquiète pas<nbsp>! Il n'y a aucune contrainte de temps, ni même de pénalité si tu tombes<nbsp>! Dans l'éventualité où tu glisserais, tu n'auras qu'à utiliser un petit geyser pour remonter et poursuivre ta course<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
安心しな！
制限時間もなければ、落下ペナルティもねーからよ！
もし落ちたら、近くの噴流に乗って復帰すりゃあいい！

entries.en: Are you ready? Then have at it! My colleagues and I will be cheering you on from down below!

ひゃっは～！　準備はいいか？
くれぐれも「魔城の中継担当」に話しかけるのを忘れるなよ！
さあ、アンタの熱ーいジャンプを見せてくれ！

entries.en: Welcome back, my athletically accomplished friend! Back to amaze onlookers with another remarkable run at the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course, are we? Splendid! You already know the rules, so feel free to hop right onto that water spout and show everyone what you've got!
entries.fr: Héhé, saluuut<nbsp>! Je savais que tu reviendrais participer à “Pas dans l'tas”<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
おーいえぇい！
またまた来てくれて、ありがとよ！
すぐに「常夏の魔城」に案内してやるぜーー！

entries.en: Oh, and don't forget to report to the chaperone at the checkpoint, yes? We wouldn't want all to see all your efforts go for naught, now would we? But enough of my ramblings. Go forth, brave and honorable Nimble Warror!
entries.fr: Tu n'as pas oublié<nbsp>? Il faut d'abord que tu montes grâce au petit geyser<nbsp>! Surtout, pense à t'adresser au responsable de mi-parcours<nbsp>! Vas-y, c'est quand tu veux<nbsp>! Bon courage<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
まずは、中継地点が目標だ！

entries.en: Your first objective is to make it to the checkpoint midway through. Remember to speak with the chaperone there before forging on to the finish line, or your triumph won't count and your acrobatic exploits will all have been in vain!
entries.fr: Tu dois d'abord atteindre la mi-parcours<nbsp>! N'oublie pas de t'adresser au responsable qui est là-bas, surtout<nbsp>! Amuse-toi bien<nbsp>!

entries.en: Most impressive, my swift and sprightly friend! I was convinced you were going to make it clear to the finish line in one fell swoop! You may have fallen short, but sweet victory is right there for the taking! Now get back out there and show the adoring crowds what you've got!
entries.fr: Ouah<nbsp>! Je suis vraiment im<->pres<->sion<->né<nbsp>! Continue comme ça, surtout<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ひゃっは～！
なかなか魅せてくれるじゃねえかーー！
いいぜ、その調子で頑張りな！

entries.en: The course will give you a challenge, but it's far from impossible─especially for an experienced adventurer like yourself, I'd wager! Keep your eyes on your landing point, don't rush your jumps, and most importantly...try not to look down!
entries.fr: Le meilleur moyen de réussir à “Pas dans l'tas”, c'est de bien regarder l'endroit où l'on va atterrir et de sauter sans s'affoler<nbsp>! Je vous souhaite bon courage<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
着地地点をまっすぐ見て、
焦らず慎重に跳ぶのがコツですよ！
頑張ってくださいね！

entries.en: Congratulations! You've made it to the halfway point! And as challenging as this course is, I daresay that's an accomplishment in itself.
entries.fr: Bravo<nbsp>! Vous avez atteint la mi-parcours<nbsp>! Je valide votre passage<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
おつかれさまです！
ここがチェックポイントの中継地点です！

entries.en: So pat yourself on the back and feel free to take a breather before you venture on. My colleague P'obyano is waiting at the finish line. Can you make your way there and claim your reward? I guess we'll see, won't we!
entries.fr: Continuez comme ça<nbsp>! L'arrivée n'est plus très loin<nbsp>! Lorsque vous y serez, adressez-vous à P'obyano<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
引き続き、頑張ってくださいね！
この先のゴール地点にいる、
「魔城の終着担当ペ・オビヤノ」さんに話しかければクリアですよ！

entries.en: Feel proud, friend! Why, many of your ungainly peers never even make it this far. But don't get too comfortable yet! Half of the course still remains, and the road won't be an easy one.

entries.en: You did it! And just as I thought you would! Right from the start, when I saw you leaping and bounding your way through the course like it was nothing, I had a feeling you were a Moonfire Faire veteran. And now I see that I was right!

Je me demandais qui c'était qui avançait avec autant d'agilité et de maîtrise, mais en te voyant arriver, j'ai tout de suite comprrris<nbsp>! Forcément, ce n'est pas ta première par<->ti<->ci<->pa<->tion aux Feux de la Mort<nbsp>!

見事な跳躍をする人がいると思って見ていたら、

entries.en: You did it! And just as I thought you would! Don't ask me why, but I had a good feeling about you right from the start! You'd better believe that at least one person who saw you conquer the course today will be strolling into their nearest Adventurers' Guild tomorrow to sign themselves up!
entries.fr: Fé<->li<->ci<->ta<->tions, tu es arrivé<if(gnum4,e,)><nbsp>! Je suis sûre que de nombrrreux gens auront eu envie de rejoindre la guilde des aventuriers en te voyant avancer avec tant d'agilité et de maîtrise<nbsp>!

ゴールおめでとう！
あなたの活躍を見て、きっと冒険者ギルドの志願者も増えるわ！

entries.en: I trust you have places to go and people to see, but should you ever wish to show off your skills again for all to see, the Eorzean Nimble Warrior course won't be going anywhere! ...At least, not until the end of the faire. You're welcome to rise to the challenge as many times as you like─simply talk to the chaperone at the starting line if you so desire!
entries.fr: Je compte sur toi pour parrrticiper à nouveau<nbsp>! Pour ça, tu n'auras qu'à t'adresser à mon collègue qui est au départ<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
よかったら、また挑戦してちょうだい！
「常夏の魔城」にもう一度挑戦するには、
スタート地点の「魔城の受付担当」に話しかけてね！

entries.en: You did it! Once again, you've made our painstakingly constructed course appear about as challenging as a leisurely stroll on the beach! If you'd care to treat the faire-goers to another display of your astounding athletic ability, you're always welcome here!
